title: The Borrowed Verdict
author: Beatrix Nakamura
blurb: Edmund Galloway, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
